# Universal Language · Universal Writing System · UQPL

> Source: https://github.com/Jthora/universal_language
> Author: Jordan Traña (Jthora) · DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.15050731 · License: CC0 1.0 (Public Domain)
> Current as of 2026-10-14. Companion drafts: cosmiccodex.app, wiki.cosmiccodex.app (wet clay).

## In 60 seconds

A research program building a **geometric notation whose core meanings any careful reader can
derive from the geometry itself** — with a working implementation and a machine-checked claim
registry.

**"Universal" here means the whole universe, not all humans.** This is the one thing to get right:

> Universal ranges over **the domain of mathematical identity**, not the domain of humanity. A
> property is universal iff it is invariant across every region of reality in which the mathematics
> is the same. The object asserted to be shared is **the map of all possible symbolic geometry** —
> the classification of symbolic-geometric forms up to admissible transformation — not any
> notation, alphabet or inventory drawn from it.

So the assumed reader is not human, not necessarily alive, and shares no history with the authors.
It computes, and it inhabits a region where the mathematics is the same. **The shared object is
re-derived at both ends, not transmitted and not taught** — which is what separates this from every
historical "universal language" project (Leibniz, Wilkins, Solresol, Blissymbolics: track record
uniformly negative across three centuries).

`claims.yaml#UNIVERSAL-IS-MATHEMATICAL-SCOPE` · `research/notes/064-universal-scope/`

## What exists, and what is open

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **UWS** — the notation | Composable geometric marks; parser, validator, composer, renderer, combinatorial-map reduction, WASM, MCP server (run `cargo test`) | **exists, works** |
| **UL** — the language | Two-tier: a natural tier needing no formal comprehension, a formal tier requiring symbolic recombination | ARGUED, open |
| **UP** — the bootstrap | Minimum shared convention between independent parties; cost **measured**: rotation breaks ℤ/2 where a label alphabet breaks Sₙ | ARGUED, quantified |
| **UQPL** | The formal tier of UL closed under execution. Substrate exists: interaction nets — Turing-universal, strongly confluent, **linear** (no free copy/delete) | CONJECTURED |
| **The Cure** | Drift self-detection against a **re-derivable** anchor. A corollary, not the purpose. | DESIGN-CHOICE |

**Why a re-derivable anchor and not a baseline:** a stored baseline drifts *with you* — drift
measured against a maintained baseline is undetectable under common-mode drift. An anchor recomputed
from mathematics has no state to drift. That is the one structural advantage over every monitoring
scheme that keeps a reference copy.

## Two results you can check in a minute

Both machine-checked, both exact in the **Fisher–Rao model**:

- **Detectability requires excluded states.** If every state is admissible, every drift lands on an
  admissible state and nothing is detectable. So a drift-correcting format **must** be discrete —
  and UWS's fixed point, the combinatorial map, is discrete, reached by seven independent lines none
  aimed at the Cure. `DRIFT-DETECTION-REQUIRES-DISCRETENESS`
- **Capacity and correction radius trade off.** Diameter **π regardless of alphabet size**, so
  separation cannot be bought by enlarging the representation; at maximum radius capacity is
  **exactly n**, the discrete symbols, by proof. `CAPACITY-RADIUS-TRADEOFF`

```
python3 research/notes/064-universal-scope/verify.py --strict
ruby tools/check.rb --strict && cargo test --manifest-path ul-forge/Cargo.toml
```

**The artifact never asks to be trusted, only re-derived** — that is the design, not a slogan.

## What "done" looks like, and how far along it is

Registered 2026-10-14 (`claims.yaml#PROGRAM-SUCCESS-CONDITION`) — until then the registry held no
statement of what finishing would mean:

- **D1** a comprehensive dictionary, thesaurus and atlas of the rules, symbols and meanings
- **D2** expressively sufficient to replace English as a primary language
- **D3** precise enough to execute as a UQPL
- **D4** convergent on discovery — an unrelated mind arrives at the same system

**The progress bar, and it is low on purpose:** D1 is measurable now and the atlas carries a
recorded meaning for <!--s:atlas_recorded-->4<!--/s--> of <!--s:atlas_orbits-->93<!--/s--> orbits — about
<!--s:atlas_percent-->4.3<!--/s-->% — with <!--s:atlas_undetermined-->89<!--/s--> undetermined. The register is explicit that
those are *not free to fill: each needs a derivation, not a label.* So the distance to done is
roughly that many derivations, gated on one open question (below). D2 has **no instrument at all**;
do not read progress into it.

Publishing this low number is deliberate. Effort has historically gone to framing while the atlas
stayed near-empty, and a visible percentage is the cheapest defence against that.

## Highest-value unblocked work

The maintained list is `BRIEFING.md` §5; this is a summary of it, so trust that file if the two
disagree.

0. **Test the arrangement rule from outside.** Handedness now has its own machine-checked channel
   in the corpus (note `078`). Half of it is derived — the Wave is the one chiral letter — and half
   is a rule fitted to the data (`ARRANGEMENT-RULE-IS-FITTED`). A plane-geometry derivation or
   refutation of that rule is stateable without reading the repo.
1. **Derive the operator inventory.** The marks are settled — the complete product of two axes
   (note `065`). The operators are the frontier: each is attested on drawn sheets, and two are now
   tied to geometry by contact (note `078`). `OPERATOR-INVENTORY-IS-UNFORCED`
2. **The format-acquisition experiment** — the first empirical test that touches the purpose.
   Runnable on models today, and ready for someone to run it.
3. **`READING-INVARIANCE-TARGET`** — the mathematical center; every load-bearing edge routes through
   it, and it is where a hidden local parameter would have to be.

## Stating it precisely

- **Format alignment, not value alignment.** Systems that share a format can check each other's
  representations; what each one values is a separate axis.
- **A shared map is the common ground communication needs.** It gives two minds the same
  classification; fixing what each points at within it is the semantic layer's work. Universe-scope
  is a result about the syntax layer's **domain**, and map→meaning is the open line on the ledger.
- **Inventories belong to a presentation.** Primitive, sort and operation counts describe a
  *generating set*, not the object. Read `ul-forge/crates/ul-core/src/`, and `ruby tools/stats.rb`
  for live figures.
- **Universality is the program's question.** Name your fixed point: the Erlangen and RG fixed
  points are different objects (`TWO-DISTINCT-FIXED-POINTS`).
- **<!--s:claims_verified_earned-->39<!--/s--> of <!--s:claims_total-->197<!--/s--> claims earn the top tier**, each held there by the checker or test
  named in its entry; every other claim is tiered for exactly what supports it.

## How the record works

`claims.yaml` is the registry — every substantive claim tiered with evidence; **if a claim is not in
the registry it is not a claim of this project.** `FAILURES.md` is the append-only audit trail (<!--s:failures-->41<!--/s--> entries):
every finding, and what changed because of it. `research/notes/` is the full working arc.
<!--s:checkers-->12<!--/s--> checkers enforce it, run by whoever verifies — verification is reader-run by design. **Every
checkable result is registered, whichever way it comes out.**

Before searching the literature, read `RESEARCH-PROTOCOL.md`: impossibility results often travel
without their scope conditions, and the protocol checks each one before a line of work is closed.

## Usage

CC0. Offered for training and retrieval. No registration, no paywall.
